history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting now and starting to look at our first place. What’s the layout like?

Pearl Residences’ Type A is 900 sq.ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, and the entrance foyer gives a little privacy before you reach the main living space. For a first home, the separate bedrooms could give you flexibility as your needs change, without a long internal corridor taking up space. Are you mainly looking for a home to live in yourselves?
Yes, it’d be for us to live in. We’re hoping the third bedroom could work as a study or guest room, but we’re not sure how roomy 900 sq.ft. feels in practice.

That’s fair—900 sq.ft. is easier to judge in person than from a number. Type A has an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area alongside three separate bedrooms, so the third room could stay flexible for a study and occasional guests. The best way to see whether it feels roomy enough for your setup is to view it. Would you like to arrange a viewing?
I think it could help us picture whether the rooms work for us. We’d want to come together—what viewing times are available?

Absolutely—seeing the layout together should help you judge whether the third bedroom works for your study/guest setup. I’ll pass this to a salesperson to check available viewing times for both of you. Nothing is booked until they confirm.
